query: select jsonb_build_object('core_version',helpdesk_auth.schema_version(),'core_forced_rls_tables',(select count(*) from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname in ('helpdesk_core','helpdesk_auth','helpdesk_audit','helpdesk_integration') and c.relkind='r' and c.relrowsecurity and c.relforcerowsecurity),'addon_owner',(select pg_get_userbyid(nspowner) from pg_namespace where nspname='helpdesk_implantacao'),'addon_forced_rls_tables',(select count(*) from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='helpdesk_implantacao' and c.relkind='r' and c.relrowsecurity and c.relforcerowsecurity),'policies',(select count(*) from pg_policies where schemaname='helpdesk_implantacao'),'definer_functions',(select count(*) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='helpdesk_implantacao' and p.prosecdef),'client_schema_access',(select jsonb_object_agg(r,has_schema_privilege(r,'helpdesk_implantacao','USAGE')) from unnest(array['anon','authenticated','service_role']) r),'documents',(select count(*) from helpdesk_implantacao.documents),'events',(select count(*) from helpdesk_implantacao.events),'receipts',(select count(*) from helpdesk_implantacao.receipts),'quotas',(select count(*) from helpdesk_implantacao.quotas)) as verification;
